purpose: Learn evidenced SEO/content methods and apply a bounded strategy to BrowserHub instead of quota-driven publishing. No traffic, ranking or backlink gain is claimed.

researchMethod.firecrawl: Previously observed insufficient credits; existing web search used without new subscription.

sources.observed: Selection includes search traffic potential, business value, ranking feasibility, intent fit and maintenance.
sources.adaptation: Before work, record who searches, the task, why BrowserHub can answer distinctly, and the next useful reader action. No paid volume estimates fabricated.

sources.type: Publisher refresh workflow and self-reported examples
sources.observed: Prioritize pages, validate update value, inspect competing results, fill gaps, then measure and iterate.
sources.adaptation: Improve existing intent owners with substantial changes. Do not merely change dates or promise their self-reported uplift.

sources.type: Content-agency argument; not official ranking mechanism
sources.observed: Argues for additive original information instead of repeating comprehensive guides; explicitly distinguishes theory from confirmed Google use.
sources.adaptation: Require a concrete added benefit such as a reproducible failure case, original local test or useful decision aid. No claim of a confirmed Google information-gain score.

sources.observed: Named task, TypeScript/Python entry points, scaffold commands, prerequisite service key and explicit steps.
sources.adaptation: Keep examples findable and runnable with prerequisites and expected outputs. Do not imply their cloud service is free or locally tested by BrowserHub.

sources.observed: Starts with a concrete developer problem; explains fixtures/hooks with code, video and docs links.
sources.adaptation: Write around a complete developer task, explain failure causes, and link to the next relevant solution. Product-led usefulness is an observed pattern, not causal traffic proof.

sources.observed: Examples organized by tasks, frameworks and languages, including login/session reuse and downloads.
sources.adaptation: Group existing articles/assets into practical journeys instead of an undifferentiated long series. Do not build the deferred detection website.

sources.type: Directly observed comparison with author-reported test method
sources.observed: Separates reported test results from documented-only features, lists pinned versions and repetition, and offers reproduction.
sources.adaptation: Borrow the evidence structure, not their numbers or prose. Their reported results were not independently reproduced in this research.

sources.type: Official Google guidance, opened in sameongoingconversation
sources.observed: Original useful information, substantive value and clear sourcing; production volume alone is not evidence of quality.
sources.adaptation: No word quota, schema/skill-count ranking promise or fabricated experience.

qualityGates.deliverable: Target question, current result URLs, observed public demand and existing owner; distinguish ownGSC queries from public discovery.
qualityGates.reject: Only a fashionable title with no user task or evidence.

qualityGates.deliverable: Read at least3 relevant competing pages and note which part BrowserHub can make more useful; link/authority metrics unknown unless actually obtained.
qualityGates.reject: Assuming a new domain will beat official docs by writing longer.

qualityGates.deliverable: A specific original explanation, configuration, tested example or clearly labeled proposed procedure that adds utility.
Clear next step and relevant internal links within task clusters; keep existing URLs stable.
qualityGates.reject: A long unstructured series or repeated keyword pages.

qualityGates.deliverable: Inventory existing useful assets, relevant resource pages and genuine mentions; determine page-level authority gap only with data.
qualityGates.reject: Assuming no backlinks, buying ranking links or sending unauthorized outreach.

qualityGates.deliverable: Matched date/page/language cohorts and validated events with missing values explicit; include reader action after landing.
qualityGates.reject: Counting publication, crawlers, totalrequests or skill installs as SEO results.

boundedExistingPageBriefs.evidence: Existing rendered article and current public results inspected; private analytics has only a very small page-level signal.
boundedExistingPageBriefs.gapToValidate: No independently documented real connection walkthrough with versioned execution evidence was found in the inspected article.
proposedIncrement: Use dedicated disposable localprofiles and exact versions for a bounded synthetic local form interaction
Record actual errors/observed outputs/screenshots if executed; no realuser-account exposure or fakecompatibility claim
Keep originalconfiguration download and link related setup/comparison guides naturally
boundedExistingPageBriefs.notClaimed: No traffic uplift or comparative reliability benchmark; publication requires completed workflow receipt.

boundedExistingPageBriefs.evidence: Existing source and current competing comparison inspected.
proposedIncrement: Compare the same small permitted local task with versioned fixtures if resources justify it
Separate documented capabilities, actually observed results and untested areas
Include reproducible inputs, failures and cleanup
Reuse existing synthetic fixtures where applicable; no paidLLM invocation needed for deterministic tool calls
boundedExistingPageBriefs.notClaimed: No traffic uplift or comparative reliability benchmark; publication requires completed workflow receipt.

costPolicy.batchArticleQuota: Daily publication restored under original approximatelyfive independentnewtopics target; do not repeat completedbatches or manufacture weakarticles.
costPolicy.scope: Evidence-backed existingowner improvements and genuinely distinct newtopics, with quality gates and cost controls.
costPolicy.cadence: Daily09:00 publishing; Monday effect review in the same task.
costPolicy.modelUse: Code for routine checks; defaultone Lunaexecution coordinator and one independentSolreview. Additional delegation only when needed.
costPolicy.publication: Reviewed frozen source, preflightCI/scopedGit, original formalgraph and dual-domain acceptance remain mandatory.

limitations: Cannot infer why a competitor ranks or its ROI from public page format alone.
Ahrefs/agency examples are their own case reports, not a BrowserHub forecast.
New skills are instructions, not paid keyword data or guaranteed outcomes.
No paid tools/subscriptions, outreach, new articles, account settings, indexsubmission or website deployment in this research.
